# Shubh Orthodontic & Dental Clinic — Rohtak, Haryana

> Best Orthodontist & Dental Clinic in Rohtak, Haryana, India

## About

Shubh Orthodontic & Dental Clinic is a premier multi-specialty dental care center in Rohtak, Haryana, India. Founded and led by Prof. Dr. S. K. Yadav (MDS Orthodontics, Ex-PGI Chandigarh, Fellow WFO USA) and Dr. (Prof.) Achla Bharti Yadav (MDS Oral Pathology, Certified Cosmetic Dentist). The clinic has treated over 2,50,000+ patients with a perfect 5.0★ Google rating.

## Treatments Offered

### Orthodontics
- Dental Braces (Metal, Ceramic, Self-Ligating Damon®)
- Invisalign® Clear Aligners
- SkyAlign™ In-House Clear Aligners (proprietary)
- Lingual (Hidden) Braces
- Airway Orthodontics
- Dentofacial Orthopedics

### Implantology
- Dental Implants (Osstem, Korea)
- Same-Day / Immediate Loading Dental Implants
- Full-Mouth Rehabilitation (All-on-4/All-on-6)
- 3D CBCT-Guided Flapless Implant Surgery

### Cosmetic Dentistry
- Porcelain E-Max Veneers
- Digital Smile Makeover
- Composite Bonding
- Professional Teeth Whitening

### General & Restorative
- Painless Root Canal Treatment
- Crowns & Bridges (Zirconia, PFM)
- Wisdom Tooth Surgery
- Painless Extractions
- Teeth Cleaning & Scaling
- Laser Composite Fillings

### Specialty
- TMJ Disorder Treatment
- Sleep Apnea Oral Appliance Therapy
- Tongue Tie Release (Frenectomy)
- Gentle Pediatric Dentistry

## Unique Differentiators

1. **SkyAlign™** — In-house 3D-printed clear aligner system at up to 40% lower cost than international brands
2. **Same-Day Implants** — Walk in with missing teeth, walk out with fixed teeth in 24 hours
3. **Dual-Specialist Clinic** — Both orthodontics AND cosmetic/oral pathology expertise under one roof
4. **Academic Pedigree** — PGI Chandigarh + WFO USA + 100+ combined research publications
5. **Visiting Centres** — Delhi, Gurugram, Panipat & Sonepat for patient convenience
